    Lemma 5.3 in its exact form #

    For admissible special biserial path data whose arrows are independent modulo paths of length two (ArrInd, true for an admissible presentation), A e_x is nonuniserial and injective exactly at the binomial vertices (bin_iff), its socle there is the line of the longest path (soc_eq), so the ideal J of exists_string_quotient is the sum of the socles of the nonuniserial injective summands, and every indecomposable module not annihilated by J is a nonuniserial projective-injective module.
